name: cc-hero
description: Guitar practice in a pane beside Claude Code: /hero scrolls a song past a now-marker as tablature and standard notation, Guitar Hero style, and scores what you play. With the microphone listener on (bun + ffmpeg, started by /hero mic on) it hears the guitar, judges each note's pitch and timing, and doubles as a tuner (/hero tune). Without it, space strums for timing practice. Needs function hooks (early access) and an interactive terminal.

micDevice.title: Mic device
micDevice.description: The audio input the listener opens: an index or a name from /hero mic devices. A USB guitar interface shows up there.

latencyMs.title: Mic latency (ms)
latencyMs.description: How late the listener hears you, in milliseconds; subtracted from every note it reports. Try 50-120 if hits read late.

beatsPerChord.title: Beats per chord
beatsPerChord.description: How many beats a chord lasts on an imported chord sheet.

stepsPerBeat.title: Tab columns per beat
stepsPerBeat.description: How an imported ASCII tab reads its dashes: 4 makes each column a sixteenth.

importBpm.title: Import tempo
importBpm.description: Tempo for an imported page that names none.

defaultStrum.title: Default strum
defaultStrum.description: The strumming pattern a progression exercise starts with: D, U, X (muted), - (rest), one token a beat.

coachModel.title: Coach model
coachModel.description: The model /hero coach and /hero lesson use.

paneRows.title: Pane rows
paneRows.description: Rows the pane asks for when it opens above the prompt (a docked pane takes the height it has).
